name: Coral bleaching
summary: No global bleaching event since June; El Niño heat stress building
state: The fourth global coral bleaching event was declared over in June 2026. Heat stress has built across the northern Caribbean, with a basin-wide alert level 1 forecast (GCRMN), and scientists in the Cayman Islands called on 29 Oct for urgent intervention to protect reefs. No new regional mass bleaching was confirmed by NOAA Coral Reef Watch as of 4 Nov.
for_you: No action needed. Reef-dependent fisheries and tourism are most exposed if bleaching returns.
rubric_hit: No global bleaching event in progress = Normal

sources.title: NOAA Coral Reef Watch — ENSO conditions and coral bleaching
GCRMN — Heat stress builds across the northern Caribbean

why: Reefs support a quarter of marine species and coastal economies; mass bleaching is a direct sign of ocean heat stress.
drivers: Marine heatwaves, El Niño, warming trend.

rubric.alert: Bleaching extent at record levels with active new alerts in the past month.
rubric.watch: Global bleaching event in progress, or regional mass bleaching.
rubric.normal: No global bleaching event in progress.
